name: font_manager_remove_path

provenance.source: Exact .155 AP-backed IDA function with font_manager_remove_path name/source strings; raw function chunk independently rehashed against the pinned AP.

notes: Takes a registry node handle, not a name. Retrieves the manager at *(*0x200bd1e8+28), checks membership in its registered-path list, unlinks via 0x0c3a46dc, then frees name, path and node via 0x0c3abe58. UI owner thread only, never under interrupt lock. Invalidates the supplied handle; existing font wrappers are not replaced by this call. Device probe pending.
